notes.title: V6.0 - Big update
notes.content:
What is added in this patch :

New features :
- You can now play with a gamepad.
- You can randomize your path without having to restart the game.
- You can find in the setting menu the number of the new path that was assigned to you.
- A link to the soundtrack was added.
- The ending scene has been changed.

Modifications:
- The monster doesn't keep following the player after death.
- One safe zone was not working properly, it's now fixed.
- Improved monster patrol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471092/1d6f8c8435e6409559f3bbb6223a33320f12c9b2.png[/img]

notes.title: V5.0 - Big update
notes.content:
[b]What is added in this patch :[/b]
[b]
New features :[/b]
- 3 achievements were added("Find the secret path", "Activate the hidden bridge" and "Find your computer").
- Functional ladders were added.
- You can now re-randomize your path in the setting menu.
- One new path was added.

[b]Modifications :[/b]
- You can stay longer in the same place before the camera shakes.
- Some paths have changed.
- An easier mechanic system to activate the hidden bridge in the end.
- Better monster spawn location.
- Cured the "heart arrhythmia" problem of Sarah (No more double heart beat).
- The secret path has changed.
- Fixed bugged textures.
- More safe zones and more batteries.
